title: Hia5 Footprinting of lig50knuc and lig50
body:
### 1. FIBER-Seq for lig50k

|---|---:|

| Hia5 buffer | **5.00 µL** |

| EDTA, 10 mM | **2.50 µL** |
| EGTA, 10 mM | **1.25 µL** |
| Spermidine, 10 mM | **1.50 µL** |
| SAM, 32 mM | **0.75 µL** |
| Hia5 | **1.00 µL** |
| Water | **2.75 µL** |
| **Total** | **30.00 µL** |
